title: Append-only deferred capability registry event
description: One line of governance/master-matrix/DEFERRED_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY.ndjson. The registry is a project-wide anti-forget spine for capabilities a gate deliberately deferred. It is NOT the GATE_STATUS_LEDGER, NOT a second gate lifecycle ledger, NOT an authority registry and NOT a defect registry: it carries no gate status transition and its events never authorize execution. Chain discipline mirrors the established non-lifecycle precedent in governance/authority/REGISTRY_AUTHORITY_MIGRATIONS.ndjson: previousEventSha256 pins the prior event's eventPayloadSha256, and the first event pins null. Identity is <sourceGate>-DC-<NN>, assigned once and never derived from content, so a legitimate RESTATE cannot change the id that consumers and revisit triggers depend on.

eventId.description: Unique event identity. Never reused, including after a terminal disposition.

ordinal.description: 1-based position in the stream. Must equal the line index; a gap or repeat is a broken stream, never a resolvable ambiguity.

deferredCapabilityId.description: PERMANENT IDENTITY. Derived from exactly two inputs: the sourceGate that made the deferral decision, and a zero-padded ordinal assigned within that gate at first REGISTER. Deliberately NOT content-derived: a content hash would change on every legitimate RESTATE and break the identity revisit triggers and consumers reference.

previousEventSha256.description: The prior event's eventPayloadSha256; null only for ordinal 1.

eventPayloadSha256.description: SHA256 over the canonical JSON projection of this event excluding previousEventSha256 and eventPayloadSha256. Always recomputed by the validator and never trusted as declared.

authorityPath.description: Repo-relative governed path of the document that authorizes this event. Absolute, drive-relative, traversing and mixed-separator paths are rejected on every host. The registry itself may never appear here: an event cannot authorize itself.

payload.description: Event-type specific body. REGISTER and IMPORT_BINDING carry the full entry; later events carry only what they change plus their required evidence.
